answer: At dawn each epoch, rewards flow only to identities whose bond exceeds the median, so a swarm of fake agents must fund every fake identity at real cost, making attacks economically self-defeating. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bonded stake to register, and every epoch a peer-reviewed mirror of its work history is checked against the crystal ledger of prior attestations. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
